links.comparator_used: Output (shape quality) detector alone, without input image domain shift detectors
links.outcome: Mean absolute error in predicted per-patient Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) for cardiac substructure autosegmentation
links.effect: MAE was lowest when combining input (image) and output (shape) detectors compared with output detectors alone; the best regression model (linear regression with bootstrap aggregation) reached an MAE of 0.041 ± 0.002 in predicted DSC. No separate MAE figure for output detectors alone is given in the abstract.
links.quote: MAE was lowest when combining both input (image) detectors and output (shape) detectors compared to output detectors alone.

design_hint: routine drift/domain-shift monitoring with performance prediction
